## Claims
- [source-backed] The reported computational range is \(r\le4,\ n-r\le5\); thus \((r,q,i,j)=(3,6,2,2)\) lies outside it. [source-6, lines 46-54]
- [source-backed] For \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), \(a=\min(q-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), and each proposed family has \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements. [source-6, lines 18-39]
- [computed] Here \(a=1,b=2,N=3\). The truncated presentation has \(65\) Schur columns, \(270\) Pieri rows, and \(1370\) direct-LR rows. The families are \(F_1=(22,32,33)\) and \(F_2=(22,221,222)\). For each \(F_\ell\), a \(62\times62\) complementary-column Pieri minor has determinant \(1\), and every direct-LR row lies in the selected Pieri lattice; direct Pieri/LR single-row mismatches were \(0\). [artifact 0b91fcbde84aa9c5a7c35b2827ba19d3c880d0cf53deaea5fad487906d234105]

  At degree \(6\), the third relation is \((32;1):321+33=0\) for \(F_1\), and \((32;1):-222+33=0\) for \(F_2\). [artifact 0b91fcbde84aa9c5a7c35b2827ba19d3c880d0cf53deaea5fad487906d234105]
- [proved] Conditional on the computed row-containment assertions, the LR relation lattice equals the selected Pieri lattice in either presentation. The unimodular complementary minor makes the quotient free on the respective three free columns, so its Smith form is \(\operatorname{diag}(1^{62},0^3)\) and \(J_v/A_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^3\), with basis \(F_1\) or \(F_2\).
- [unsupported] The artifact records a “direct-LR” computation but does not document source code or individual LR-to-Pieri integral combinations; implementation independence and the requested independent review remain unaudited.

## Strategy
Use the \(65\)-column Schur presentation for shapes containing \(22\) in the \(6^3\)-box. Compare selected Pieri lattices against direct LR rows, then certify saturation by the displayed unimodular complementary minors.

## Gaps
The failed preliminary sandbox run is not evidence. No standalone Smith-reduction transcript or explicit integral reduction coefficients for all \(1370\) LR rows were retained. Thus this is a bounded finite computation, not an independently audited certificate.

## Next
Retain explicit LR-row combination coefficients and separately audit a second LR/Smith implementation before treating this as independently verified.
